description: This file defines the ServiceSpecificConfig interface, which provides common configuration settings for Ditto services. It extends other configuration interfaces and declares methods to access LimitsConfig and HttpConfig configurations.

classes.name: ServiceSpecificConfig
classes.description: A Java interface providing method signatures for accessing service-specific configuration objects such as limits and HTTP configuration, integrating clustering and metrics configuration functionalities.

methods.name: getLimitsConfig
methods.description: Returns the LimitsConfig instance associated with the service, representing various operational limits.

methods.name: getHttpConfig
methods.description: Returns the HttpConfig instance associated with the service, containing HTTP communication settings.
